atoms.a: Ich auch. Wie viel Taschengeld bekommst du?
atoms.b: Me too. How much pocket money do you ((++get become))?
((++How_often How_much)) do you get your pocket money?

atoms.a: Ich bekomme mein Geld einmal pro Woche. Wie ist es bei dir?
atoms.b: I get my money once a ((++week day)). What about you?

atoms.a: Ich bekomme jeden Monat 20 Pfund als Taschengeld.
atoms.b: I get £20 as pocket money every ((month)).

atoms.a: Das ist echt cool. Dann hast du viel Geld auf einmal und musst nicht einen ganzen Monat warten, um 20 Pfund anzusparen.
atoms.b: That's really cool. Then you have more money at once and don't have to wait a whole month to ((++save earn)) up £20.

atoms.a: Ja, das ist definitiv ein Vorteil. Allerdings muss ich sehr vorsichtig sein, nicht alles auf einmal ausgeben.
atoms.b: Yes, that's definitely an advantage. However, I have to be very cautious and not ((++spend pay)) it all at once.

instruction.text: Amanda berichtet von ihrem ersparten Geld. Lies dir den Text durch und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.text: I don't spend all of the pocket money I get from my parents. I save some money every month. I get £20 from my parents and I usually save a quarter of that, which is £5. I do that, because I sometimes want to buy expensive things like brand name products. However, it is a difficult task. I find it hard to stop myself from spending all of my pocket money immediately. It's not easy, because I always find something I would like to buy at markets or shopping centres.

atoms.a: How much money does she save?

b: She saves money, because she doesn't need that much money.
++She save money, because she wants to buy expensive things.

atoms.a: Does she find it hard to save money?
b: No, she thinks it is easy.

atoms.a: Why does she find it difficult to save money?
b: ++She always finds something she would like to buy.
She doesn't have a money box.

instruction.text: Ergänze die Sätze mit den jeweils passenden Begriffen.

atoms.a: Phoebe arbeitet einmal pro Woche als Nachhilfelehrerin, um zusätzliches Geld dazuzuverdienen.
atoms.b: Phoebe works as a ((++tutor babysitter)) once a week to ((++earn pay)) some ((++extra_money extra_sheets)).

atoms.a: Freddie probierte verschiedene Nebenjobs aus, wie Babysitten, Rasenmähen und Zeitungsaustragen.
atoms.b: Freddie tried different ((++side_jobs clothes)), like ((++babysitting helping_older_people)), ((++mowing_the_lawn working_at_supermarkets)) and ((++delivering_newspapers selling_newspapers)).

atoms.a: Ich spare Geld, indem ich etwas davon in meine Spardose stecke.
atoms.b: I ((++save cost)) up money by putting some in my ((++piggy_bank wallet)).
